Background (from the session that started this one):
Branch claude/setup-card-headline (commit f964221268, not pushed, cut from jusprin-newui 8913319cac) replaced the setup card's preset-difference rows with the plan headline and made each chat store its own intent and plan. In a 12-journey live batch on DeepSeek V4 Flash, all 12 runs called plan_set and every changed-strategy run rewrote its headline. But in two runs the purpose title (intent_update) stayed on the old goal, so the card contradicted itself. This is a separate prompt problem from the headline work, and it predates that branch.

Task:
In JusPrin's agent chat, the setup card's title is the chat's recorded print purpose (setupTitle, stored as setupIntent and written by the intent_update tool). Its headline is the plan headline written by plan_set. In a live evaluation on 2026-10-19, two of three "changed strategy" journeys left the title stale. The user first asked for a spiral-mode dried-flower vase, then said it must be watertight and carryable. The model rewrote the plan headline to a multi-wall strategy but never called intent_update, so the card's title still said "spiral vase for dried flowers" above the new headline.

Task:
1. Find what the project prompt (src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/AgentUI/src/projectInstructions.ts), the intent_update and plan_set tool descriptions (src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Agent/ToolRegistry.cpp), and the skills under AgentUI/src/skills/ say about updating the purpose when the user changes their goal. Follow AGENTS.md and Kenneth's rules: standing prompt text states principles only, situational text comes from state channels, and a rule lives next to what it governs.
2. Propose the smallest wording or state change that makes the model update the purpose when the goal changes. Explain it to Kenneth before any live-model test.
3. Run no live-model calls without Kenneth approving a specific batch (runs x estimated tokens). The journey transcripts showing the problem are saved in the shared notes folder as plan-journey-batch-b/ (runs changed-2 and changed-3). The temporary --plan-journey harness mode is plan-journey-harness-mode.patch in the same folder. Keep that patch out of any commit.

Done means: a proposed change with its reasoning, implemented and covered by the existing prompt fixtures and tests once Kenneth agrees, plus a live check of the changed-strategy journey if he approves one.

Shared notes folder for this group of sessions (outside the repo; read siblings' notes there, leave hand-over notes or large findings there instead of pasting them into messages): /Users/kenneth/Library/Application Support/Claude/side-session-notes/local_e78f817e-dfbf-4d43-8f9b-f15ee63b4baf

commit 28d6d67fdc0411373eb0fb98350d857779206b9e
Author: Kenneth Jiang <kenneth.jiang@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 20:12:22 2026 -0700

    Merge intent_update and plan_set into one tool, setup_record
    
    In batch B's changed-strategy runs the model rewrote the plan headline with
    plan_set but never called intent_update, so the setup card's title still
    named the old goal above the new strategy. The two records make up the card
    and were already handled as one (same coordinator block, both in-app only,
    both on the chat, the same context push), so they become one tool.
    
    setup_record takes:
    - setupTitle, required on every call: what the person wants, in their words.
      Restating it with each plan keeps title and headline from drifting apart.
      A title the chat refuses (more than one line or 120 characters) records
      nothing, the plan included.
    - fields, optional, with intent_update's semantics (assumed, question,
      provenance).
    - plan, optional: headline, decisions, assumptions, risks. Given, it
      replaces the whole plan; left out, the plan is kept. A purpose can be
      recorded before a strategy exists: a title-only call, the setup check,
      then a later call with the plan.
    The result carries the intent section, purposeChange and the setup in force
    as intent_update's did, and always the plan as it now stands. The
    description keeps the concise-headline wording and states the split: the
    title is what the person wants, the headline is how the agent will print.
    
    The setup-changed skill fires on a setup_record whose purposeChange is
    first or changed (a first purpose or changed fields), as before; a new
    title alone is title_only, and a call that only restates the purpose to
    change the plan is unchanged, so neither fires it. The card's context is
    pushed once per successful call, so title and headline arrive together.
    
    Changes to the model's input: one tool where there were two (27 project
    tools, not 28), the project prompt's "recorded with setup_record", and the
    setup-changed skill's "record the plan and its assumptions with
    setup_record first". tests/project_prompt: grading, script, README,
    project_tools.json and requests.json updated and re-recorded with the
    scripted model; no live calls.

I made no edits and created no worktree, because the fix this subtask was meant to propose already exists on the branch. The handoff assumes claude/setup-card-headline is still at f964221268. It is not: its tip is now 28d6d67fdc, "Merge intent_update and plan_set into one tool, setup_record", committed today at 20:12 in the serene-snyder-280b07 worktree.

**What that commit changes.** The model used to call two tools: `intent_update` wrote the setup card's title and `plan_set` wrote its headline. The commit replaces them with one tool, `setup_record`.
- `setupTitle` is required on every call. The tool description says the title is "what they want, in their own words", restated unchanged when it hasn't changed.
- The description tells the model to call it again "whenever the purpose or the strategy changes, so the title and headline stay true".
- The plan goes in an optional `plan` argument. Leaving it out keeps the current plan.
- The project prompt and the setup-changed skill now name `setup_record`. The commit message says the prompt test suite's recorded requests were re-recorded with the scripted model, with no live calls.
